p: rebellious children: Who contrary to their promise take not me for their protector and contrary to my commandment seek help from strangers.
cover with a covering: They seek shifts to cloak their doings and not godly means.
princes were at Zoan: The chief of Israel went into Egypt as an ambassador to seek help and abode at these cities.

burden of the beasts of the: That is, a heavy sentence or prophecy against the beasts that carried their treasures into Egypt, by the wilderness, which was south from Judah, signifying that if the beasts would not be spared, the men would be punished much more grievously.
concerning this: That is, to Jerusalem.
is to sit still: And not to come to and fro to seek help.
it before them in a tablet: That is, this prophecy.
time to come for ever and: That is may be a witness against them for all posterity.

hear the law of the LORD: He shows what was the cause of their destruction and brings also all misery to man: that is, because they would not hear the word of God, but delighted to be flattered and led in error.
deceits: Threaten us not by the word of God, neither be so rigorous, nor talk to us in the Name of the Lord, as in Jer 11:21.
oppression and perverseness: Meaning, in their stubbornness against God and the admonitions of his prophets.
a piece to take fire from: Signifying that the destruction of the wicked will be without recovery.
Lord GOD: Often by his prophets he put you in remembrance of this, that you should only depend on him.
horses: We will trust to escape by our horses.
top of a mountain: Whereas all the trees are cut down save two or three to make masts.
gracious to you: He commends the great mercies of God, who with patience waits to call sinners to repentance.
Not only in punishing but in using moderation in the same, as in Jer 10:24,30:11.
walk ye in it: God will direct all your ways and appoint you how to go either hither or thither.
defile also the covering of thy: You will cast away your idols which you have made of gold and silver with all that belongs to them, as a most filthy thing and polluted.
Be gone from me: Showing that there can be no true repentance, unless both in heart and deed we show ourselves enemies to idolatry.
mountain: By these various manners of speech he shows that the happiness of the Church will be so great, that no one is able sufficiently to express it.

sun shall be sevenfold: When the Church is restored, the glory of it will pass seven times the brightness of the sun: for by the sun and moon which are two excellent creations, he shows what will be the glory of the children of God in the kingdom of Christ.
the name of the LORD cometh: This threatening is against the Assyrians the chief enemies of the people of God.
vanity: To drive you to nothing: and thus God consumes the wicked by that means, by which he cleanses his.
night when a holy solemnity is: You will rejoice at the destruction of your enemies, as they who sang for joy at the solemn feast, which began in the evening.
rod: God's plague.
which the LORD shall lay upon: It will destroy.
tabrets and harps: With joy and assurance of the victory.
with it: Against Babel, meaning the Assyrians and Babylonians.
Tophet is ordained of old: Here it is taken for hell, where the wicked are tormented, read 2Ki 23:10.
king it is prepared: So that their estate or degree cannot exempt the wicked.
deep and large: By these figurative speeches he declares the condition of he wicked after this life.
